options.orbit: Threshold, then a central void. You pass between two objects and a screen just inside the door, then circle one hero object standing alone in a large empty void ringed by six small objects. Product stations sit at the four outer corners, outside the loop. The pay desk closes the loop at the back. Size: default 20 x 16 m.
options.field: One open low field. A floor strip leads from the door to a single large hero object; four sculptural stations hold the product in a loose ring around it, and the route wanders between them to the pay at the back right. Nothing but the hero is tall. Size: default 16 x 12 m.
options.chamber: A room inside the room. A walled chamber with two side openings stands in the middle; three low monoliths inside it carry the product; two blocks break through the chamber walls. The route enters the chamber, circles the monoliths and leaves. There is no single hero: the chamber is the event. Size: default 18 x 12 m.
options.ritual: A small ritual room. Shelf walls wrap the left, right and back; one object at the centre is where you pause first; a counter sits at the back. The route circles the centre, then follows the shelves. Size: default 12 x 10 m.

reply.title: Threshold of the Rainy Night
reply.subtitle: An olfactory sanctuary carved from basalt and reflective horizons.
reply.line: You step from the bustling street into a silent, rain-drenched void where the scent of basalt and cold air lingers in the dark.
reply.synopsis: As you cross the threshold, the cacophony of the city dissolves into a rhythmic stillness defined by damp, polished concrete floors. You navigate between looming black basalt monoliths that display fragrance vials like sacred artifacts caught in the moonlight. Reflective aluminum walls expand the space, blurring your reflection against the deep, wet textures of the room. By interacting with the crushing stone protrusions, you feel the raw tension between the natural landscape and the refined architectural interior.
reply.quote: Silence is the architecture of rain, and scent is the memory of the stone it touches.

why.meaning: The walled chamber isolates your senses from the external world to create an immersive, meditative environment.
These stone pedestals force you to slow your pace and engage intimately with the fragrance collection at eye level.
The protruding rocks disrupt the perfect geometry of the walls to remind you of the untamed nature breaking through the sterile design.
Placing the payment and fitting areas outside the core ensures that the sanctuary remains a place of pure, undisturbed sensory contemplation.
